title: Tank Hip 듀오 #20 (프레임 힙컷 · 수조 수위 가득/비움 · 체형 USSBBW · 메이크업 페르시안글램 / 요루바신부화장 · 물색 emerald-green, coral-pink · 내용물 반딧불이 밤/없음 · 유리 라일락, 로즈핑크)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip statue portrait. TWO women standing side by side, each angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so every woman's whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips a short way down her thighs, just below the hip line, each face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop. Where a sculpted form comes to an end at the thighs, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off. Generous spacing so every figure reads clearly, nobody's arms crossing a neighbour. Every sculpture stands directly on the floor on its own two rounded tips, with the polished floor visible beneath and around them and no pedestal, so no figure floats in the air.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Iranian woman — richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in twin-tail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Physique: A colossal chest, a waist that pulls in sharply beneath it, wide flaring hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#1 Body: From a straight line at the height of her armpits down, her whole body — chest, belly, hips, both arms from the upper arm down, both hands and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of extremely thin, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, filled completely to the brim with vividly coloured emerald-green water, so nothing is hollow and there is no air gap. The vessel holds ONE single world, unbroken and continuous through her whole chest, belly, hips and both thighs, with no split, no second world and no change of contents anywhere: a warm summer night: hundreds of small glowing fireflies and a scatter of tiny floating paper lanterns drifting in the emerald-green water that fills her body, from her chest down through her thighs. The vessel is ONE single continuous hollow from the armpit line down to the tips of both thighs, with no wall, partition, seal or valve anywhere inside it between the torso and the thighs, so the water behaves like real water: it settles at the very bottom first, filling both thighs completely, and rises evenly through the hips and belly to its one level waterline — the thighs are never empty while the torso holds water, and the water stands at the same height everywhere inside. The water is clearly and richly coloured — far more saturated than the almost colourless glass — so exactly how much water there is reads at a glance; its surface is a crisp, bright, sharply defined line, and any part of the vessel above it stays clear and colourless. The glass is unmistakably glass but extraordinarily thin and transparent: a single hair-thin, polished shell carrying only a faint tint of its own colour, like a delicate coloured film — the colour deepens only slightly along its thin rims and where the glass curves edge-on, while the face of every surface stays almost perfectly clear — so delicate that it is almost invisible, revealed by bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights, fine refraction edges along its thin rims and tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself; the backdrop and its light sources are seen straight through the vessel with almost no distortion. Her chest, belly, hips, arms and both thighs keep their exact sculpted shapes as clear glass outlines, and a clean glass rim runs along the boundary where the vessel meets her real skin at the armpit line. A short way down her thighs, just below the hip line, each thigh individually curves inward and seals shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip — both sealed rounded tips rest side by side directly on the floor, touching it, with a soft contact shadow where each tip meets the floor and no gap beneath them; the sculpture stands on the floor on its own two tips and nothing floats in the air. Her body below the armpit line is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears, neck, shoulders and upper chest stay opaque living flesh. Her glass is tinted delicate lilac-violet.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Yoruba Nigerian woman — rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, soft pastel-pink hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown.

#2 Body: From a straight line at the height of her armpits down, her whole body — chest, belly, hips, both arms from the upper arm down, both hands and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of extremely thin, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, completely empty: the vessel holds no water, no liquid and no objects of any kind, only clear air inside its sealed hollow. The vessel is her body itself, not a shell worn around a body, with no human body, skin, flesh or organs inside it, so the backdrop is plainly visible straight through it. A short way down her thighs, just below the hip line, each thigh individually curves inward and seals shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip — both sealed rounded tips rest side by side directly on the floor, touching it, with a soft contact shadow where each tip meets the floor and no gap beneath them; the sculpture stands on the floor on its own two tips and nothing floats in the air. Her glass is tinted soft rose-pink.

Boundary for each woman: a single straight, perfectly horizontal line runs all the way around her body at the height of her armpits, straight across her chest and her back and across the tops of both upper arms — real skin above it (her face, ears, neck, shoulders, upper chest and the tops of her upper arms), thin glass immediately below it. The line is straight and level, never jagged and never zigzag. At that line, the glass edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow — her skin beside it stays smooth and even. Each rounded tip is the glass's own finish — never the edge of a photograph.

Setting: a huge plain white backdrop wall behind them marked with a sparse grid of very thin hairline black lines in large squares, widely spaced, never thick, never bold, never dense, with a pale polished floor beneath them.

Pose: each stands tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand relaxed at hip height, every hand well away from every face, heads tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the striped backdrop is seen straight through every transparent body, its lines bending and shifting slightly through the thin glass, and any hair hanging behind a body is plainly visible through the empty glass. A soft frontal light falls on all the faces and ears; a thin cool rim light traces every figure. Only each woman's face, ears, neck, shoulders and upper chest read as real skin. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
